title: The Equipoise Canon
summary: A canon of holding two opposing forces in perfect balance and breaking an assault by setting its equal against it.

title: Course in the Unmoved Center
summary: A course in a living field with a still hub at its middle where every force pulling on the student cancels out.

title: The Twin Scale Treatise
summary: A treatise on weighing two forces on twin pans so that the heavier is lowered and the lighter is raised.

title: Basin and River Equilibrium Compendium
summary: A compendium on a basin that holds level and a river that keeps its measure so that waters of any depth are made even.

title: The Wind-Sworn Level Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the level that a wind-sworn student keeps on the plateau against every gust that would tilt it.

title: The Oath of the Even Plateau
summary: A manual of the sworn level that spreads over the open field and flattens every extreme set against the oath.
